//: `npm install` cannot install this project at all. npm 10's dependency
resolver crashes -- `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`
-- while working out vitest's peer dependencies, and it crashes before
installing anything, so the build never starts. It is an npm bug, not a
bad dependency: bun installs the same package.json in under a second.
The lockfile in the repository is bun.lock. There is no package-lock.json
and there cannot be one until npm can resolve the tree, so pointing Vercel
at npm means pointing it at a command that fails every time.
If this is ever moved back to npm, generate a working package-lock.json
FIRST and check that a clean clone installs from it.
